verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs state you can always export your notes into an open format such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder repeats this on HN as the answer to lock-in concerns. The evidence is thin, though: both statements are brief and come from the vendor. Nothing specifies whether the export is a complete bulk export, or whether attachments, images, backlinks and note history carry over. missing for 10: detailed export documentation covering all data types (files/images, links, history), confirmation of full bulk export, independent hands-on corroboration of a clean migration out.
